bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to children and families; modifying SNAP income and asset requirements; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 142F.101.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 142F.101, is amended to read:

142F.101 INCOME AND ASSET LIMITATIONS FOR SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM HOUSEHOLDS.

Subdivision 1.

Income limits.

The county or Tribal agency must determine each Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) household eligible for the benefit discussed under section 256.029. Each SNAP household must demonstrate that its net income meets federal SNAP requirements and its gross income is equal to or less than 200 percent of the federal poverty guidelines for the same family size.

Subd. 2.

Asset limits.

Each SNAP household must demonstrate that it meets the personal property limitations under section 256P.02, except that a vehicle with a trade-in value equal to or greater than $100,000 is not excluded under section 256P.02, subdivision 3, and must be applied to the personal property limitations under section 256P.02, subdivision 2.
